[[/hcell]] [[hcell colspan="3"]] Trim (Torim) / Aero [[/hcell]] [[/row]] [[row]] [[cell colspan="3"]] A pet with high powered PAs, focusing on quality over quantity. They are best suited to pursuit agile enemies with their fast Stab and their double DoT attacks. Their main weakness is their lack of wide area attack, PP inefficiency, low defense, and weakest normal attacks (i.e. not worth for Spirited Parfait). If you can, switch to Trim or Aero during a boss' downtime, such as when Dragon drops its head, Deus showing its core etc. and perform Shout then Spiral to their weak points. In order to maximize their damage, try to land as many full-charged Shout-Spiral as you can.

★14 Trim is more durable with higher HP and Def and less PP usage. ★14 Aero has higher Pwr, upgraded Aero Spriral (wider attack area) and Aero Slash (stronger). There are little reasons to use Trim, so the numbers listed on here are based on Aero.

Trim and Aero are currently having limited uses as they are outclassed by their glass cannon peers: Shinkuro and Popple; and fellow avian, Rappy. [[/cell]] [[/row]]

Personality Description
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Industrious (がんばりや Diligent//) 115% PA damage with 130% PP cost. Preferable for the big damage boost.
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Smart Cookie (おりこうさん Docile//) 121% damage on enemies with a status effect. Since EQ bosses does not get status effect like normal enemies, the boost will be useless there.
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Elite// (エリート) ★14 only. Combines Industrious and Smart Cookie, as well as having increased rare item drop rate.

[[table class="wiki-content-table border-top-none border-bottom-none"]] [[row]] [[hcell class="border-top-none"]] Strength [[/hcell]] [[hcell class="border-top-none"]] Weakness [[/hcell]] [[/row]] [[row]] [[cell class="pros-cons-list pros w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Suitable for all player skills
  • Easy-to-use Boss killer
  • High Pwr
  • Stab is a low-risk, high damage PA

[[/cell]] [[cell class="pros-cons-list cons w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Weakest normal attack
  • Third lowest DEF
  • High PP usage
  • Low PP regain from attacks
  • Low DPS rate in the long run because low PP regain.
  • Requires constant use of Shouted Spiral Charge 2 in order to reach full potential
  • Torim recovers long from stun

[[/cell]] [[/row]] [[/table]]

    • 3 Spirit Cookies (Spirita Cookies)

[[/cell]] [[/row]] [[/table]]

1 DPS: Damage Per Second, the higher the better.
2 Normal Attack DPS Rating: The DPS rating of Normal Attacks. Hold is the DPS if you hold the normal attack button. Auto is the number if you let the pet attack freely. If only Hold exists, then the pet will do less if you don't hold the button. The number in bracket is the restored PP per second, disregarding natural PP regen.
3 Overall DPS Rating: The greater the number, the greater the pet's DPS potential is. This is calculated by using Glance of Darkness with Rykros Staff +30, during standard case scenario: Phantom sub, enemy is weak to pet's element, enemy isn't moving, a pair of 110% damage parfaits, using PA to deplete 200PP, then use Normal Attacks to get back 200PP (boosted natural PP regen and attack PP regen due to Phantom sub is calculated).
4 Sweets in bold are currently what Manaka put on her pets. For more information about Sweets, see the [#recommended-candies Recommended Sweets] Section.
